beats: 0-1s empty base in overhead close: empty tray / dry noodles / oiled tortillas / flat tortilla / open buns. 1-6s fast 0.7-1s cuts on beat, one layer per cut: fries fall, cheese shower, meat mound, onion, cilantro, sauce zigzag, bacon, broth scoop. 6-9s payoff hold 2-4s: broth pour soaks, fold and press, wrap and knife-cut, lift whole roll to show size, orbit plate.
can_make: We can make the order, rhythm, text and music from real menu photos with Ken Burns push-ins and 4s AI push-ins, and house cast holding the finished roll, bowl or tray. We cannot make real falling, scattering, pouring, melting, bubbling, browning, steaming or knife-cutting - AI hands warp and cheese, sauce and noodles smear.
core: An empty plate fills layer by layer until it overflows, proving abundance.
es_camera: Solo una cámara real da la caída, el queso derretido, el vapor, el brillo y el corte real.
es_can: Podemos armar el orden y el ritmo con fotos del menú y modelos que sostienen el plato final.
es_core: El plato vacío se llena capa por capa hasta rebosar y eso vende abundancia.
fits: Loaded fries, birria ramen, birria tacos on griddle, wraps, double crispy burgers, burritos, burger lines, sushi sets. Any buildable dish where height and layers sell value.
name: Build-Up Stack
needs_camera: Real falling and piling weight, cheese melting and bubbling, meat juice and gloss, steam, sauce flow, tortilla folding and browning, real knife cut to hot layered cross-section in continuity.
people: Hands only in black gloves, no faces. Cook hands drop, spread, pour, sprinkle and fold from top or side. Sometimes torso in red apron or white shirt behind counter.
variants: Base: foil tray, ramen bowl, black griddle, flat tortilla, yellow board, burger line, glazed plate. Order: cheese-first vs meat-first. Structure: empty-first vs money-first where finished giant is shown first then rebuilt. Payoff: broth pour plus noodle pull, griddle fold plus tray, tortilla fold plus split, wrap plus cross-section, orbit of set.

beats: 0-1s macro grip: hand lifts finished triangle, burger, pizza slice or arepa to lens. 1-4s wet it: dunk tip in red consomme, pour white-green or yellow cheese sauce, saw through with knife, tilt to drip. 4-9s hold: lift dripping, tear or separate halves to stretch cheese, hold cross-section with meat and melt to camera.
can_make: We can rebuild the 2-3 beat edit, framing, text and music from real menu photos and 4s AI clips of house-cast hands holding, dipping, lifting and tearing. The drip stream, broth coating and long cheese strands will look thick, soft and warped and will not hold physics.
core: One finished hot item is lifted, wetted and opened in macro to prove juice and melt.
es_camera: Solo una cámara real da el jugo que gotea, el queso que se estira y el corte caliente real.
es_can: Podemos fingir que se levanta y se abre con fotos y manos falsas, pero el líquido y el queso se ven falsos.
es_core: Se levanta y se abre una pieza caliente para mostrar que está jugosa y con queso.
fits: Quesabirria tacos, birria quesadilla triangles, smashburgers, pepperoni pizza slices, stuffed arepas. Any single item with melted cheese plus juice or sauce.
name: Juicy Proof Touch
needs_camera: True liquid contact: broth soaking and dripping in continuous stream, sauce clinging and running, thin unbroken cheese strings, clean new cut face with steam, grease shine and finger grip without warping.
people: Hands only, no faces. Bare or gloved hands pick up, dunk, tear, cut with knife, lift with chopsticks or fingers, pour from cup or bottle. One variant uses a female presenter holding taco and cup toward lens.
variants: Wet: red consomme dunk, white-green squeeze pour, yellow cheese drown. Opener: tear apart, knife cut and pull, chopstick lift, finger lift and tilt. Cheese: quesadilla strings, burger melt lines, pizza stretch. Holder: anonymous cook hands vs presenter looking at food.

beats: 0-1s tight on foil or paper ball with hook text, crinkle ASMR, no food visible. 1-3s both hands peel and fold wrapper back to expose bun top. 3-8s lift and tilt unwrapped burger to lens as sauce oozes and drips, hold; variant adds second cheese pour or rotation.
can_make: We can rebuild layout, cuts, text and crinkle ASMR from real wrapped and unwrapped burger photos with AI-drawn gloved hands and 4s AI peel, lift and tilt clips. Foil tearing will look melted not torn and sauce drip will loop and smear, and our cast never bites.
core: The burger stays hidden in foil then is peeled open to pay off with oozing melt.
es_camera: Solo una cámara real da el papel que se rompe, el crujido y el queso caliente que cae de verdad.
es_can: Podemos armar la sorpresa con fotos y manos falsas, pero el papel y el queso no se mueven como de verdad.
es_core: La hamburguesa escondida se abre en cámara y sale el queso.
fits: Double smash burgers, cheeseburgers in foil, paper-wrapped brioche burgers. Any handheld that hides well and oozes when opened.
name: Foil Peel Reveal
needs_camera: Real continuous unwrap in one take: fingers denting and tearing reflective foil with synced crinkle, hot cheese slumping, stretching and dripping without morphing, and real pink bitten interior with steam if a bite is shown.
people: Hands only, no faces. Black-gloved tattooed hands or manicured hands hold ball, peel foil down, then hold burger up. Never eats in our version.
variants: Wrapper: white paper over foil vs crinkled foil ball. Hook: peeling-fruit joke vs send-to-hungry text. Payoff: slow tilt-drip vs double cheese drown vs rotation. Sound: foreground crinkle ASMR vs low music.

beats: 0-4s empty setup: empty table, phone with food photo, empty tray with emojis, fists ready, menu read. Hands do trick: wipe blur, pinch-drag, cursor click, rock-paper-scissors pumps, point to summon. 4-5s hard cut on beat drop to full food. 5-9s slow push and slide across finished spread, bowls or burger plus juice, hold.
can_make: We can make wipe blur, phone mockup, emoji plus cursor pops, floating cutouts and still fists plus hard cut to plates held by house cast, all from real menu photos with 4s AI push-ins and edit. We cannot make live synced fist pumps, seamless pinch weight, continuous walk-ins, or real bites and sips - our cast holds and shows and never eats.
core: An empty scene plus a playful trick ends with a full table by magic.
es_camera: La magia simple no necesita cámara, el juego en vivo, el paseo y morder sí.
es_can: Podemos hacer que la comida aparezca con fotos y trucos de edición, pero sin juego en vivo ni prueba de bocado.
es_core: Con un truco la mesa vacía aparece llena y eso divierte y muestra variedad.
fits: Combos, trays, loaded fries plus tacos, pasta plus salad, burger plus juice. Any choice or value spread where cooking is not needed.
name: Magic Appearance
needs_camera: Live synced rock-paper-scissors pumps and throws, real pinch-drag shadow and steam, real walk and plate weight, real bite, chew and sip proof. Pure wipe and click pop-ins need nothing.
people: Hands only or one seated woman. Two forearms play, fingers pinch, hand wipes, model reads menu and points, house-cast hands hold finished bowls and plates still toward lens.
variants: Trigger: lens wipe, phone pinch, menu click, rock-paper-scissors, point-to-imagine. Reveal: full cafe spread, 3-compartment plate, combo tray, two bowls together, floating burger plus juice then real. Sound: rock-paper-scissors chant plus beat drop.

beats: 0-2s food big in foreground: fisheye salmon plates, patio plates approaching, cake macro, branded bags shown. 2-6s carrier leans or walks to lens, fills frame, stares, points or smiles. 6-10s removal: walk past out of frame, carry off one plate at a time, multi-fork attack to crumbs, handoff plus tie-shoe plus sprint. Hold empty table or plate.
can_make: We can fake setup from real menu photos on plates plus house-cast model walk-up and slide-off in 4s AI clips with meme text and music. A 5-meter walk carrying 4 stable plates, true grip weight, patio depth and multi-hand fork fight will warp and swim.
core: The food gets close enough to eat then someone else takes it, leaving loss.
es_camera: Solo una cámara real da el paseo con platos reales y que la comida desaparezca de verdad.
es_can: Podemos fingir que acercan y se llevan la comida con fotos y un modelo, pero el paseo se ve falso.
es_core: La comida pasa cerca y se la lleva otro y eso da antojo y risa.
fits: Glossy salmon plates, patio salads and meats, coconut cake, takeaway bags. Any recognizable dish where disappearance reads without eating close-ups.
name: Food Gets Taken
needs_camera: Real unbroken walk from back to table carrying real weight with balance and eye contact, real storefront and patio depth with reflections, real multi-fork collision and truly scraped crumbed plate, real run with bags.
people: One man as waiter or thief walking, leaning, pointing, carrying plates or bags, tying shoe. Or group of friends leaning in with forks. Woman at side table blurred.
variants: Stealer: waiter walk-past, storefront take-one-by-one, friends gang-up, bag beg plus steal-and-run. POV: locked table-level vs fisheye. Ending: empty table, empty blue plate with crumbs, ready-to-chase pose. Text joke vs pure action.

beats: Single locked medium 0-9s with no fast cuts: lift or cut bite, bring to mouth, bite, chew eyes-closed, smile. Overlay price or love-language text. Room tone or music runs continuous.
can_make: We can make the tabletop from real menu photos plus AI model holding or presenting with slow push-in, text and music. We cannot make cut, lift to mouth, bite, chew, swallow or eyes-closed enjoyment - our cast never eats and 4s AI mouths warp.
core: A real diner takes the first bite and the face proves it is good.
es_camera: Solo una cámara real da el mordisco, la masticada y la cara de disfrute.
es_can: Podemos mostrar la mesa y el plato con un modelo, pero no morder ni disfrutar.
es_core: Ver a alguien morder y disfrutar prueba que está rico.
fits: Fried-chicken burgers, grilled steak boards, small seared bites. Any dish where tenderness, crunch or juiciness reads on the face.
name: First Bite Reaction
needs_camera: Real person in real busy restaurant cutting, biting, chewing and reacting with closed eyes and smile in one continuous take, with real gloss, crunch and background diners.
people: One young man or woman facing camera at table, lifting, biting, chewing, reaching for next piece. Blurred second hand or wine glass in foreground.
variants: Dish: burger plus nuggets, sliced steak, small beef bite. Joke: bank-account splurge text, love-language text, bite-to-senses flash montage with eye, flower, wave, lightning and powder logo. Sound: room and eating vs music vs orchestral swell.

beats: 0-2s wide establish: sun overhead spread orbit, dark pass push, black-table spread, full wooden table reveal. 2-8s fast holds: finger or chopstick lift each bite dripping, macro push on tartar and sauces, spoon pour, torch sear. 8-13s context: menu flash, sake pour, glass offer, cutlery set, creamy cut and fork lift, end logo.
can_make: We can remake order, cuts, music, voiceover and text from real menu photos with 4s AI push-ins, orbits, smoke flicker and house-cast holding, presenting and carrying stills. We cannot fake real dripping strands, liquid pours, torch flame, steam and smoke curl, or live service walks and handoffs.
core: Show a lot at once in the real place, then hold each piece close to prove wet and fresh.
es_camera: Solo una cámara real da el brillo, el vapor, el fuego y el restaurante lleno de verdad.
es_can: Podemos armar el recorrido con fotos y modelos que presentan platos, pero sin cocina ni servicio real.
es_core: Se muestran muchos platos juntos y luego cada uno de cerca para antojar.
fits: Taco spreads with ramen and churros, sushi assortments, Nikkei signatures, set meals with meat plus cake plus coffee. Best for variety, value and trust.
name: Abundance Tour
needs_camera: Real gloss, steam and drifting smoke, real sauce pours and drips, real blowtorch flame, real sake and wine pours, real dining-room depth with chefs plating and servers carrying to full tables.
people: Hands only lifting with fingers and chopsticks plus staff: chef in white coat pushing plates, servers carrying trays and pouring, manicured hand setting cutlery. No eating, no talking to camera.
variants: Stage: sunny outdoor black table, dark pass, black-table sushi, warm dining room, wooden set table. Mover: handheld orbit, push-in, lift-and-hold, follow serve. Proof: dip and cheese-pull, dripping chopstick hold, creamy fork lift. Sound: Latin dance, funk-pop vocal, cinematic voiceover, French count.

beats: 0-15s single locked eye-level close, shallow focus: hand slides stone bowl from blur to sharp center, later sets tiki mug left, both sit still while recognizable show plays on laptop behind, laugh track carries hold to credits.
can_make: We can fake layout from real tartare photo cut sharp foreground plus generated table and fake royalty-free cafe screen, with two 4s AI slide and place clips and frozen hold. We cannot fake licensed show video and laughs or true blur-to-sharp gloss.
core: Cozy dinner is served in front of a comfort show so you picture yourself eating there.
es_camera: Solo una cámara real da el enfoque real, el peso al servir y un programa conocido.
es_can: Podemos fingir el plato frente a una pantalla, pero sin programa real ni enfoque perfecto.
es_core: La cena se sirve frente a tu serie favorita y se antoja por comodidad.
fits: Tartare towers, bowls and novelty mugs or cocktails. Late-night cozy comfort dishes.
name: Dinner And Show
needs_camera: Real camera on real table for true depth rack from blur to tack-sharp, weight of hand setting cold bowl and heavy mug, sauce gloss and table reflections, laptop glow, and real licensed show playing in sync.
people: Hand only entering low left to place bowl and mug then leaving. No faces, no eating. Actors appear only inside laptop screen.
variants: Swap tower or bowl, swap mug or drink, swap show clip, swap booth table and glowing wall. Keep locked two-plane rack and laugh-track hold.

beats: 0-7s single overhead close on griddle: five cheese-topped patties sizzle in fat, cheese softens and droops, spatula and tongs nudge one patty, slight shake, hold melt.
can_make: We can imitate from a real patty photo with 4s slow push-in, added gloss and steam shimmer and sizzle sound. It reads as finished dish, not live cooking. Bubbling fat, drooping melt and spatula nudge will look false.
core: Stare without cuts at cheese melting over crust on a greasy flat-top.
es_camera: Solo una cámara real da la grasa burbujeante y el queso derritiéndose.
es_can: Podemos imitar el brillo con una foto, pero no la cocina en vivo.
es_core: Mirar el queso derritiéndose sobre la carne caliente abre el apetito.
fits: Smash patties, American cheese burgers. Any live griddle melt with sizzle.
name: Flat-Top Melt Stare
needs_camera: Real camera over real hot flat-top: live grease bubbling and browning, cheese going matte to glossy and slumping, spatula scraping and lifting crust, true fat and steel reflections, clean take.
people: Nobody. Only off-camera spatula and tongs enter from right to nudge.
variants: Patty count, cheese slice type, nudge timing, text or no text. Keep one continuous stare take with sizzle forward.

beats: 0-3.3s overhead two pastas and two wines, two forks twirl at same time, static. 3.3-5.5s hard cut on beat to two desserts and two coffees, fork cuts cheesecake while spoon presses tiramisu, text overlay, hold.
can_make: We can remake both beats from real pasta and dessert photos overhead with wine and coffee composited plus house-cast hands and 4s AI twirl and cut clips, static overhead, text and music. True stretch and resistance will be soft.
core: Two people eat the same second so you feel like sharing the table.
es_can: Podemos armar las dos manos comiendo a la vez con fotos y manos falsas.
es_core: Dos personas comen al mismo tiempo y te sientes en la mesa.
fits: Tomato and creamy spaghetti plus cheesecake and tiramisu. Sharing pasta and dessert menus for couples.
name: Synced Tasting POV
needs_camera: Nothing essential - only true pasta stretch, sauce shine and real spoon resistance in tiramisu.
people: Hands only: two women's hands with light manicure from top and bottom edges holding fork and spoon to twirl and cut. No faces.
variants: Pasta pair, dessert pair, wine and espresso swap, text line, romantic music. Keep overhead locked and synced timing.

beats: 0-11s locked eye-level medium two-plane: woman frozen behind with spoon to lips eyes-closed smiling, foreground plate hard-cuts every 2s to five desserts with yellow label, music beats.
can_make: We can rebuild as composite: house-cast model smiling eyes-open with fork up and real dessert photos cut onto foreground plate with slow AI push-in and hard cuts plus labels. We cannot copy spoon-at-lips closed-eyes tasting because our cast never eats.
core: One frozen taster holds the same bite while many desserts swap in front of her.
es_camera: Solo una cámara real da la cucharada en la boca y la reacción de disfrute.
es_can: Podemos cambiar los postres frente a la modelo, pero sin probar de verdad.
es_core: La misma catadora prueba muchos postres y eso muestra variedad.
fits: Waffles, alfajores, cheesecakes, crema volteada, fruit rolls. Cafes with dessert variety.
name: Frozen Taster Swap
needs_camera: Real tasting proof: real spoon to mouth, closed eyes and chew with consistent terrace light and plants, plus long unbroken take proving same person saw all five plates.
people: One young woman seated outdoors frozen whole Reel: spoon to open mouth, eyes closed smiling, other hand on table. No talking or movement.
variants: Dessert and label swap, terrace backdrop, Latin jazz. Keep same framing and frozen pose, change only foreground plate.

beats: 0-4s fork locked center while background jump-cuts every 0.4s on beat: plaza, clock, lights, cake case, wood wall, wine bottles, kitchen. 4-9s lower fork to creamy bowl, twist, slow lift bundle with hanging strands, macro drip hold.
can_make: We can make payoff from real pasta photo with house-cast hand plus 4s AI lower, twist and lift clips and suggest travel with fast slideshow of exterior and interior photos plus drawn fork overlay and music. Same hand, nails, fork and backgrounds will drift and warp.
core: One fork travels from the street into the kitchen to prove this pasta is worth the walk.
es_camera: Solo una cámara real da el paseo con el mismo tenedor y la pasta alzada de verdad.
es_can: Podemos fingir el viaje con fotos y el tenedor dibujado, pero el paseo se ve falso.
es_core: El tenedor viaja desde la calle hasta la pasta y eso cuenta una historia.
fits: Single signature creamy spaghetti in tourist old-town spots. Walk-in story dishes.
name: Follow The Fork Walk
needs_camera: Real walk in one grip through square, entrance, case, bar and live kitchen with real chef, plus real twirl physics: sauce gloss, herbs, strands stretching and dripping in warm low light unbroken without warping.
people: Hand only: woman's right hand with purple glitter nails and black sleeve holding fork tines-down whole way, then twisting and lifting. Blurred passersby and chef behind.
variants: Route landmarks, bowl style, music. Keep fork centered and travel cuts on beat, then long slow-motion lift.
